# Input

> An animated text input for React and shadcn, with leading and trailing addons and an error state.

- Docs and live demo: https://eased.dev/components/input?ref=context7
- Source: [src/registry/eased/input/](../../src/registry/eased/input/)
- Installs: `components/eased/input/input.tsx`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`, `motion`

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn add @eased/input
```

Or by URL:

```bash
npx shadcn add https://eased.dev/r/input.json
```

Import paths below assume the default `@/components` alias in `components.json`.

A text input on Base UI's Input.

```tsx
import { Input } from "@/components/eased/input/input";

<Field label="URL" validate={checkSlug} validationMode="onChange">
  <Input start="eased.dev/" value={slug} onValueChange={setSlug} />
</Field>
<Input aria-label="Amount" end="EUR" invalid={tooHigh} />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | `"md"` | 32, 36 or 40px. |
| `start`, `end` | `ReactNode` | | Leading and trailing addons (icon, prefix, unit, button). |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | | For use outside a Field; inside one, the field's validity drives it. |
| `className` | `string` | | The bordered shell. |
| `controlClassName` | `string` | | The `<input>`. |

Plus every Base UI Input prop (`value`, `defaultValue`, `onValueChange`, `type` …). Text is 16px on touch screens so iOS never zooms on focus.

**Motion signature:** focus firms the border one step and a soft glow grows around it; an error does one 6px horizontal shake, then the message opens with a height spring.

## Reduced motion

This component's README does not describe its reduced-motion branch. The rule every animated Eased component follows, from the [motion docs](https://eased.dev/docs/motion?ref=context7#reduced-motion):

> Every animated component has a reduced branch. When the visitor's system asks for reduced motion, movement becomes a 100ms opacity fade (`reducedFade`) or nothing, and looping animations stop.
